9. Given no fire or smoke was noted on the façade of Wang Cheong House facing Kwong Wang Street, a passer-by led me to the rear façade of Wang Cheong House facing Island House Lane via the pedestrian pathway between Wang Cheong House and Wang Shing House. At the open ground near the rear exit of Wang Cheong House (i.e. at the east side of the block between flat 4 and flat 5), I noted the scaffolding structures at the exterior of Wang Cheong House facing Island House Lane was well alight (Layout Plan (2) refers). The area on fire measured approximately 8 meters in width by 30 meters in height, from ground floor to about the eighth / ninth floor.
